{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[Quelev Tapper]] headed an '''organization''' of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that profited from the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the organization was entrenched in Imperial territory and a local [[Governor/Legends|governor]] authorized an assault force to destroy the group's headquarters. [[Talon Karrde]] came to Tapper's aid, and the remnants of Tapper's organization&mdash;about a quarter&mdash;were merged with [[Car'das/Legends|Karrde's organization]].<ref name="First Contact">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref>
